provenance.generator: Py-Enigma EnigmaMachine.key_press / get_display, independent of the TypeScript application
provenance.author: Brian Neal
provenance.seedAlgorithm: Python random.Random; iterate itertools.permutations(I II III IV V, 3), then B/C
provenance.indexConvention: Rotors, rings, windows ordered left to right; A=0; ring A=01 in UI
provenance.generationNotes: Only A-Z are generated, because punctuation policies differ between applications. 728-1027 letters per case; all streams contain at least one observed consecutive middle-rotor movement. Checkpoints include first five keys, each 26th key, all left-rotor advances, and final state.
